problem_plain: VMO2 had siloed operations and legacy tech stacks following a 2021 merger, requiring digital modernisation with customer experience as a central operating model priority.
capability: Cloud-based digital core unifying omnichannel customer data and Amazon Connect AI-powered contact centre with real-time AI agent assist
scale_outcomes: NPS uplift of up to 35 points in some service areas and 89% same-day complaint closure
reusable: Cloud-based digital core architecture for omnichannel customer data unification, and Amazon Connect contact centre platform with AI agent assist capabilities
summary: Veridane modernised VMO2's digital core with a cloud-based platform unifying omnichannel customer data and Amazon Connect contact centre, driving first-contact resolution with AI-powered agent assist. The implementation achieved an NPS uplift of up to 35 points in some service areas and 89% same-day complaint closure.
